Container.Name: spamfilter-rspamd
Container.Overview: rspamd scanner for the IMAP spam filter stack. Reads its `local.d` config from the mounted appdata directory, picks up the controller password from the file written by bootstrap.sh (`/mnt/user/appdata/spamfilter/state/controller.password`), and listens on 11333 (scan) and 11334 (control + web UI). Run the bootstrap script once before installing this container.
Container.PostArgs: -c "set -e; mkdir -p /etc/rspamd/local.d; cp -a /etc/rspamd/local.d.src/. /etc/rspamd/local.d/; [ -n \"$RSPAMD_PASSWORD\" ] || { [ -f /state/controller.password ] && export RSPAMD_PASSWORD=$(cat /state/controller.password); }; [ -n \"$RSPAMD_PASSWORD\" ] || { echo 'no RSPAMD_PASSWORD - run bootstrap.sh first'; exit 1; }; envsubst < /etc/rspamd/local.d/worker-controller.inc.template > /etc/rspamd/local.d/worker-controller.inc; rm -f /etc/rspamd/local.d/worker-controller.inc.template; exec /docker-entrypoint.sh rspamd"
Container.Requires: Run unraid/bootstrap.sh first (creates the spamnet network, the appdata layout, and the rspamd controller password file).

Config.Name: Controller UI
Config.Description: rspamd controller HTTP (UI + /learn endpoints). Bind only to LAN or 127.0.0.1.

Config.Name: local.d configs
Config.Description: Filled by bootstrap.sh from this repo's rspamd/local.d/.

Config.Name: rspamd state
Config.Description: rspamd-managed runtime state (caches). Does not need backup.

Config.Name: Filter state (read-only)
Config.Description: Mounted read-only so rspamd can read /state/controller.password (auto-generated by bootstrap.sh).

Config.Name: RSPAMD_PASSWORD (override)
Config.Description: Leave blank to use the auto-generated value from /state/controller.password. Only set this to override.
